title: Thadam
shortDescription: Thadam is a modern mobility platform designed to simplify car rentals and shared transportation. The platform connects vehicle owners and customers through a convenient digital experience, enabling users to discover vehicles, make bookings, manage rentals, and access flexible mobility services.
problem: Traditional car rental and local transportation services often involve manual booking processes, limited vehicle choices, and inefficient communication between customers and vehicle providers. Users need a simple and reliable platform to discover available vehicles, compare options, make bookings, and manage their rental experience digitally.
solution: Savrion developed a scalable mobile and backend ecosystem that connects customers, vehicle owners, and administrators through a unified platform. The solution integrates vehicle listings, user authentication, booking management, rental workflows, location services, notifications, payments, and administrative controls to provide a seamless digital mobility experience.
results: Digitized the vehicle rental journey, simplified vehicle discovery and booking, improved communication between customers and vehicle providers, reduced manual rental management, and created a scalable foundation for expanding mobility and transportation services.

title: Workin
shortDescription: Workin is a modern employee attendance and workforce management platform designed to simplify attendance tracking, employee management, leave management, payroll workflows, and workforce administration. It helps organizations manage employee operations efficiently through a centralized digital platform.
problem: Businesses often rely on manual attendance registers, spreadsheets, and disconnected systems for managing employee attendance, leave, working hours, and payroll. These processes can lead to errors, administrative overhead, and limited visibility into workforce performance. Workin provides a centralized solution to digitize and simplify everyday employee management.
solution: Savrion developed a scalable workforce management platform with a mobile-first interface and centralized backend architecture. The solution integrates employee management, attendance tracking, leave workflows, working-hour records, payroll-related data, notifications, and administrative controls into a unified system, enabling organizations to manage their workforce efficiently.
results: Reduced manual attendance management, improved employee and HR visibility, streamlined attendance and leave workflows, simplified workforce administration, and established a scalable foundation for payroll and HR automation.

title: Airspace Map
shortDescription: Airspace Map is a web-based drone airspace visualization and mapping platform designed to help drone operators, pilots, training organizations, and businesses understand and plan operations within regulated airspace. The platform provides interactive map visualization, airspace information, location-based analysis, and operational planning capabilities.
problem: Drone operators often need to understand airspace restrictions, operational zones, geographic boundaries, and location-specific constraints before conducting flights. Existing information can be fragmented across multiple sources, making airspace assessment and operational planning time-consuming and difficult. Airspace Map was developed to provide a centralized, intuitive platform for visualizing and analyzing drone airspace information.
solution: Savrion developed a modular web-based GIS architecture combining interactive mapping, geospatial data processing, API-driven services, and a scalable backend. The platform integrates map layers, airspace data, location-based services, and user interactions through a responsive web interface, enabling real-time visualization and efficient airspace analysis.

title: Flytutor
shortDescription: Flytutor is a DGCA-authorized Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO) and drone technology platform providing professional drone pilot training, advanced drone programs, workshops, aerial services, and industry-focused drone education. The platform connects drone technology, training, and real-world applications to build skilled professionals for the growing UAV industry.
problem: The rapidly growing drone industry requires skilled pilots, practical training, regulatory awareness, and industry-ready technical knowledge. Traditional training approaches often lack hands-on exposure to real drone operations and specialized applications. Flytutor was established to provide structured, practical, and industry-oriented drone training aligned with regulatory requirements and emerging UAV technologies.
solution: Savrion developed and supported a digital technology ecosystem for Flytutor, combining modern web and mobile technologies with drone training and operational workflows. The solution enables course management, learner engagement, training information, digital services, application management, and integration with drone technology programs through a scalable software architecture.
results: Expanded access to professional drone pilot training, streamlined digital course discovery and enrollment, improved learner engagement, supported multiple specialized drone training programs, and established a scalable digital ecosystem for drone education, training, and technology services.

title: UAV Data Viewer
shortDescription: UAV Data Viewer is a web-based platform designed to visualize, analyze, and manage data collected from unmanned aerial vehicles. It enables users to view aerial datasets, geographic information, flight-related data, and mapping outputs through an intuitive interactive interface.
problem: UAV operations generate large volumes of aerial imagery, flight data, geographic information, and mapping outputs that can be difficult to organize and analyze using conventional tools. Users need a centralized platform to visualize UAV datasets, inspect geographic information, and efficiently interpret collected aerial data.
solution: Savrion developed a modular UAV data visualization platform integrating interactive GIS maps, aerial data processing workflows, geospatial visualization, and a scalable backend architecture. The system enables users to upload, organize, visualize, and analyze UAV-generated datasets through an intuitive web interface while providing a foundation for advanced analytics and future AI-based processing.
results: Centralized UAV data visualization, simplified aerial dataset analysis, improved accessibility of geospatial information, faster inspection of drone-generated data, and a scalable platform for integrating advanced GIS, analytics, and AI capabilities.

title: Aviatricks
shortDescription: Aviatricks is a drone technology company focused on developing innovative UAV solutions, flight control systems, drone platforms, and customized aerial technologies for industrial, agricultural, mapping, surveillance, and other specialized applications.
problem: Drone applications often require customized hardware, reliable flight control, mission planning, telemetry, and application-specific solutions. Off-the-shelf systems may not provide the flexibility, localization, and customization required for specialized UAV operations. Aviatricks focuses on developing integrated drone technologies tailored to specific operational and industry requirements.
solution: Savrion supported the development of a modular drone technology ecosystem combining embedded flight-control systems, UAV communication protocols, ground control software, telemetry, mission planning, and application-level interfaces. The architecture enables integration between drone hardware, flight controllers, MAVLink-based communication, ground control systems, and specialized UAV applications.
results: Enabled development of customized UAV platforms, improved integration between drone hardware and software, streamlined flight-control and mission-planning workflows, supported multiple drone application areas, and established a scalable technology foundation for advanced UAV development and future autonomous drone solutions.

title: Drone Commander
shortDescription: Drone Commander is a customized Ground Control Station (GCS) platform designed to provide professional drone operators with a unified interface for mission planning, real-time flight monitoring, telemetry management, vehicle configuration, and autonomous drone operations.
problem: Drone operators and organizations often require a customized ground control solution that can integrate with different UAV platforms while providing an intuitive interface for mission planning, telemetry, vehicle configuration, and real-time flight monitoring. Standard GCS platforms may not provide the required branding, workflows, integrations, and application-specific features.
solution: Savrion developed and customized Drone Commander as a modern UAV Ground Control Station built around MAVLink-based communication and drone autopilot integration. The platform provides communication between the ground station and UAV, enabling mission planning, telemetry visualization, vehicle configuration, flight monitoring, and control through a customizable cross-platform interface.
results: Created a customized GCS experience for UAV operations, improved mission-planning and flight-monitoring workflows, enabled flexible integration with supported autopilot systems, and established a scalable platform for advanced UAV operations, telemetry, autonomous missions, and future AI-powered drone capabilities.

title: Solar Mark
shortDescription: Solar Mark is a drone-based solar panel inspection and analysis platform designed to help users visualize solar installations, identify panel-level issues, map solar arrays, and generate structured inspection reports from high-resolution aerial imagery and orthomosaic data.
problem: Large-scale solar installations contain hundreds or thousands of panels, making manual inspection time-consuming, difficult to document, and prone to human error. Operators need an efficient way to analyze aerial imagery, identify individual solar arrays, locate potential issues, and generate accurate inspection documentation.
solution: Savrion developed a geospatial solar inspection workflow that processes high-resolution orthomosaic imagery and site-plan data to visualize solar installations. The platform allows users to overlay site plans, identify and separate solar panel arrays, define panel boundaries, assign array names, and generate structured inspection outputs for further analysis and documentation.
results: Reduced manual solar-site inspection effort, simplified solar-array identification and mapping, improved organization of inspection data, enabled faster analysis of large solar installations, and created a scalable foundation for integrating AI-based panel defect detection and automated inspection workflows.
